story.summaryEn:
Introducing our 2027 Atlassian Williams F1 Team challenger name - the FW50.
The designation skips straight from this year’s FW48, just as the team skipped from FW38 to FW40 on its 40th anniversary.
detailZh:
阿斯顿·马丁威廉姆斯F1车队公布了2027年的赛车名称为FW50。
这一命名直接跳过了今年的FW48，正如车队在其40周年时从FW38跳到FW40一样。
detailEn:
Introducing our 2027 Atlassian Williams F1 Team challenger name - the FW50.
The designation skips straight from this year’s FW48, just as the team skipped from FW38 to FW40 on its 40th anniversary.
